entityTax: Corporate income/franchise tax; pass-through entity tax (optional election)

permitFee.note: Business tax registration fee for the first seller's permit, covering two years; renewal is $10 every two years.

penalty.note: 5% of the tax for each month or part of a month the return is late, up to 25%, plus a $20 late-filing fee.

workersComp.threshold: 3 employees, or $500 of payroll in a calendar quarter

unemployment.note: $50 for a quarterly wage report filed within 30 days after the due date, and the greater of $100 or $20 per employee when filed later.

newHire.note: No current official penalty amount for a late new hire report was found; secondary sources conflict or give only the federal $25 and $500 ceilings.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: Twice the premium not paid during the uninsured period or $750, whichever is greater (Wis. Stat. 102.82).
